featured_reviews.name: Sharda Gujar
featured_reviews.review_text: I hv been ordering food since long here… food is completely home made n very tasty …. If u r searching for home made food then it is 100 on 100 experience…. The owner is very humble n cooperative…. Would thanks her to serve such a wonderful service!

featured_reviews.name: Anushka Rajesh
featured_reviews.review_text: Swad Kitchen is synonymous to simple and soulful food. I have personally tasted a lot of the dishes - be it rice dishes or roti-subzi dishes, and one thing that stands out is that the flavours taste like home and are super delicious! We also requested catering of Chinese cuisine for a party at our college for over 200 guests, and everyone had great feedback not only about the food but also the delivery, packing and other associated services. My friends, relatives, family and I also enjoy and vouch for the special sweets and snacks during festivals - we've tasted these during Diwali and absolutely love it!!

featured_reviews.name: Ramsha Tausalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: This 44 year old Desi Chinese chain in Bandra sure lives up to its reputation. My Tiffin is a frills free joint, with all its delight packed inside the food. We had the Seafood Noodles that had a lot of fish and prawns, the Chicken Wantons in which the winner was the red sauce, Cracking Fish Rice which had a crunch in every bite and the Dragon Chicken Sizzler that had noodled and a red chicken gravy topped off with fries. My Tiffin really is as classic as it gets.

featured_reviews.name: Zoya Memon
featured_reviews.review_text: This 44 year old restaurant serves authentic Chinese since 1980 love this place alot they hav best Chinese food i tried their mocktails & cranberry iced tea , Tiffin special soup was delicious then for d starter i tried Sesme toast & Chicken wongton fry their red sauce has real magic for wongtons 😍🤌🏻Chicken pot noodles were fully loaded nd lastly tried their korean rice 🍚 this place is a must visit guys

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food:* 4.5/5

The real star of the show was the food. We ordered the following dishes:

- *Sesame Paneer Tikka:* A game-changer! The paneer was cooked to perfection, with a beautiful balance of crispy exterior and soft interior. The sesame seeds added a delightful crunch and nutty flavor.
- *Sizzler:* A MUST-TRY! The sizzler was a masterclass in textures and flavors. The vegetables were cooked just right, and the sauce was tangy and savory. The portion size was generous, and the sizzling hot plate added to the drama.

featured_reviews.name: Johnny Carcamo
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent food – proper Chinese Hakka, very tasty and the portions were amazing. Highly recommend ordering directly from them to save. As an expat Canadian, I can say you have to try this place – authentic flavors and great value!

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Sahani
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Food was absolutely yummy and delicious.  Its a good place to hang out with your friends and family to satisfy your hunger. The place is known for authentic chinese food. Each dish is made with proper balance of spices and flavours within it.  The food was made of less oil, which is the best part.
The staff and the owner is friendly.

featured_reviews.name: Sameer Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are in Bandra East area and looking for a daily tiffin service then look no further, 'Tiffin Service by Prachi Kadam mam is undoubtedly the best one you can find. The food is overwhelmingly delicious and exceptionally healthy. The food proportion is generous and you get plenty of variety in meal plans everyday. The price is the lowest you can find in the area and they provide a timely doorstep delievery for a nominal charge. They use their own steel containers and cloth bags so there is no wastage of plastic containers and utensils.

The service is run by a wonderful and caring family of 5. Their tiffins are as good as your own mother lovingly cooking and packing it for you (for me it is even better as my mom tasted it once and gladly admitted that the taste is better than her own cooking)
